017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev;
018
019import java.util.*;
020import java.util.stream.*;
021
022import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.petstore.dto.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.console.*;
025
026/**
027 * The server half of the Custom cards page's validated card type: an inventory gauge for one species.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * The JSON5 body is {@code {species, low, high}} ({@code low} defaults to 0, {@code high} to 100).  A bad body fails
031 * the page at render time, so the page fails loudly instead of drawing a broken gauge.  A good one is shaped into
032 * {@code {gauge:{species, low, high, dataUrl}}}, which the {@code inventory-gauge} handler in {@code petstore-cards.js}
033 * draws.
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
036 * <p class='bftl'>
037 *    &lt;@card id="gauge" type="inventory-gauge" title="Dog inventory"&gt;{species:'DOG', low:20, high:120}&lt;/@card&gt;
038 * </p>
039 * <p class='bjava'>
040 *    <jc>// Registered once, on the console's FreeMarker mixin.</jc>
041 *    ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.<jsm>create</jsm>().cardType(<jk>new</jk> InventoryGaugeCardType()).build();
042 * </p>
043 */
044@SuppressWarnings({
045   "java:S1845" // type() returns the public TYPE constant; the shared name is intentional
046})
047public class InventoryGaugeCardType implements CardTypeHandler {
048
049   /** The card type name. */
050   public static final String TYPE = "inventory-gauge";
051
052   /** The endpoint the gauge reads its counts from, before the {@code species} query parameter. */
053   public static final String DATA_URL = "/console/dev/cards/inventory?species=";
054
055   private static final String SPECIES_NAMES = Arrays.stream(Species.values()).map(Enum::name).collect(Collectors.joining(", "));
056
057   @Override /* CardTypeHandler */
058   public String type() {
059      return TYPE;
060   }
061
062   @Override /* CardTypeHandler */
063   public JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source) {
064      var body = source.json();
065      var raw = body.getString("species");
066      if (raw == null)
067         throw source.error("type='%s' requires 'species'.", TYPE);
068      var species = species(source, raw);
069      var low = whole(source, body, "low", 0);
070      var high = whole(source, body, "high", 100);
071      if (low < 0)
072         throw source.error("low '%s' must not be negative.", low);
073      if (low >= high)
074         throw source.error("low '%s' must be below high '%s'.", low, high);
075      var gauge = new JsonMap()
076         .append("species", species.name())
077         .append("low", low)
078         .append("high", high)
079         .append("dataUrl", DATA_URL + species.name());
080      return new JsonMap().append("gauge", gauge);
081   }
082
083   private static int whole(CardSource source, JsonMap body, String key, int def) {
084      var v = body.get(key);
085      if (v == null)
086         return def;
087      if (v instanceof Number n) {
088         var d = n.doubleValue();
089         if (d == Math.rint(d) && d >= Integer.MIN_VALUE && d <= Integer.MAX_VALUE)
090            return n.intValue();
091      }
092      throw source.error("%s '%s' must be a whole number.", key, v);
093   }
094
095   private static Species species(CardSource source, String raw) {
096      try {
097         return Species.valueOf(raw.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
098      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
099         throw source.error("unknown species '%s'; choose one of: '%s'.", raw, SPECIES_NAMES);
100      }
101   }
102}
